tickets.title: Coordinate IRA transfer address exception with Paper Otter and Velvet Acorn
tickets.text: Coordinate the rejected IRA rollover request with Paper Otter Retirement Services and Velvet Acorn Custody for Selma Copperwisp, whose former Silver Marmot Robotics 401(k) plan address differed from her current residential address.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to coordinate the exception by August 25, 2026.

tickets.title: Resolve joint account registration mismatch
tickets.text: Reconcile the registration mismatch for Selma and Graham Copperwisp's joint account, where the transfer paperwork listed joint tenants with rights of survivorship while the Clockwork Clover Brokerage statement shows tenancy by entirety registration.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the mismatch by August 22, 2026.

tickets.title: Resolve duplicate receiving account shell at Velvet Acorn Custody
tickets.text: Resolve the duplicate temporary taxable account shells created for Selma Copperwisp at Velvet Acorn Custody, ensuring Clockwork Clover Brokerage's pending ACATS request is associated with the correct shell.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to resolve the duplicate shell issue by August 23, 2026.

tickets.title: Handle Copper Firefly Semiconductors manual transfer
tickets.text: Handle the $180,000 Copper Firefly Semiconductors position in Selma Copperwisp's individual brokerage at Clockwork Clover Brokerage outside the standard ACATS feed during the current processing window.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to handle it by August 28, 2026.

tickets.title: Adjust cash holdback before taxable account transfer
tickets.text: Adjust the ACATS instruction for Selma Copperwisp's individual brokerage at Clockwork Clover Brokerage to retain cash for property tax and estimated tax payments normally funded from that account, rather than moving all cash to Velvet Acorn Custody.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the cash holdback by August 21, 2026.
